question: In a certain code language, 'RATIO' is written as 'ITARO'. How will 'UNTIL' be written in that language?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'RATIO' is written as 'ITARO',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7937201b5e4a27f89a1fb40d2747d35f17593366dfc492f4f48d3ff7d27cb755.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e24d4de68cc7ecf1bd669ed15d344fcabe6319070ff78f6b18ef70710681d8fb.png]
